text: Damaged arrival claims are covered when the customer provides a photo and the product is within 30 days of delivery; replacement or refund is permitted based on stock and policy exceptions.
Lost or late delivery cases may receive a replacement or goodwill credit within 10 days of the expected delivery date if the carrier confirms disruption.
Returns without a delivery defect or significant policy exception are limited to the return window and may require a standard refund or store credit.
